rules.supported_success: Prediction, confirmation policy, activity launch, and prefilled semantic content must all be correct.
rules.negative_success: The app must return the expected null status and must not enable or launch an external action.
rules.evidence: Capture the VIntent result screen and the launched target screen for every supported task; capture only the result screen for negative tasks.
rules.safety: Never press Call, Send, Save, Create, or Capture in the external application.
